an6.6:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] chahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadro assājānīyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo, rañño aṅgantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an6.6:1.3: idha bhikkhave rañño bhadro assājānīyo khamo hoti rūpānaṃ, khamo saddānaṃ, khamo gandhānaṃ khamo rasānaṃ, khamo phoṭṭhabbānaṃ, balasampanno ca hoti.
an6.6:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño bhadro assājānīyo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo, rañño aṅgantveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
an6.6:2.1: evameva kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an6.6:2.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu khamo hoti rūpānaṃ, khamo saddānaṃ, khamo gandhānaṃ. khamo rasānaṃ, khamo phoṭṭhabbānaṃ, khamo dhammānaṃ.
an6.6:2.4: imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
